第79章 警监说：欢迎指导工作-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

市第一人民医院，急诊通道。

医护人员将担架从救护车上推下来，一路小跑往里送。

顾承安紧跟在担架旁边。

急诊分诊台的护士看到担架推过来，刚要按常规流程安排，随行的医护抢先交代了一句：“乙醚吸入性昏迷，市局的人，上面打了招呼，安排单独病房。”

护士点了点头。

流程走得很快，苏楠被送进了住院部的一间单独病房，房间不大，但设备齐全。

医生做完基础检查，转头对顾承安说：“患者生命体征平稳，乙醚吸入量不是很大，预估一到两小时内会自行苏醒，目前不需要特殊治疗，持续吸氧就行。”

“明白。”顾承安点头。

医生走后，他去缴费窗口垫了一千块住院预交押金。

回到病房找了个凳子坐了下来。

他拿起手机看了一眼时间。

从饭店出来到现在，满打满算不到一个小时。

这时一阵脚步声从走廊尽头传来，不止一个人，步伐急促。

顾承安转头看去。

果然是冲着他们来的，都穿着警服，走在最前面有两人，身后跟着三个随行人员。

顾承安第一时间看向肩章。

最前边那位——橄榄枝+两枚四角星花。

副厅或者正厅。

右边那位——两杠三星。

后面三人，一个捧着花束，另一个提着果篮，最后一人拎着个手提袋。

阵仗不小。

顾承安从椅子上站起来，在两人走到面前的一刻，他率先抬起右手——

敬了一个标准的警礼。

敬的是对方的职级，也是对方代表的那身制服。

警监脚步微顿，随即立正，标标准准地回了一礼。

礼毕，警监开口，态度温和且谦逊，没有任何官架子：“顾专员，您好，我是鹏城市局局长何向东，欢迎您莅临鹏城，指导、监督我们市局的工作。”

称呼是“您”。

态度是“指导监督”。

“局长客气了。”顾承安收礼，“我就是碰巧在场，换了谁都会这么做。”

Municipal First People's Hospital, emergency channel.

The medical staff pushed the stretcher off the ambulance and ran all the way inside.

Gu Chengan followed closely beside the stretcher.

The nurse at the emergency triage desk saw the stretcher being rolled over and was just about to follow the regular procedures when the accompanying medical staff said first: "Ether inhalation coma. People from the city bureau have informed me to arrange for a separate ward."

The nurse nodded.

The process went quickly, and Su Nan was sent to a separate ward in the inpatient department. The room was not big, but well-equipped.

After the doctor finished the basic examination, he turned to Gu Chengan and said: "The patient's vital signs are stable and the amount of ether inhaled is not very large. He is expected to wake up on his own within one to two hours. No special treatment is needed at the moment. Just continue to inhale oxygen."

"Understood." Gu Chengan nodded.

After the doctor left, he went to the payment window and paid a thousand yuan advance deposit for hospitalization.

I returned to the ward and found a stool to sit on.

He picked up his phone and looked at the time.

It took less than an hour from the time we came out of the hotel.

At this time, a burst of footsteps came from the end of the corridor. There were more than one person walking quickly.

Gu Chengan turned around and looked.

Sure enough, they were coming for them. They were all wearing police uniforms. There were two people walking at the front, followed by three entourages.

Gu Chengan immediately looked at the epaulettes.

The one in the front - olive branch + two four-pointed star flowers.

Deputy hall or main hall.

The one on the right - two bars and three stars.

There were three people behind, one was holding a bouquet, another was carrying a fruit basket, and the last one was carrying a handbag.

The battle is not small.

Gu Chengan stood up from his chair. When the two of them walked in front of him, he took the lead in raising his right hand——

A standard police salute was given.

What you pay respect to is the rank of the other party and the uniform that the other party represents.

The police inspector paused slightly, then stood upright and returned the salute in a standard manner.

After the ceremony, the police superintendent spoke with a gentle and humble attitude, without any official pretensions: "Hello, Commissioner Gu, I am He Xiangdong, director of the Pengcheng City Bureau. Welcome to Pengcheng to guide and supervise the work of our municipal bureau."

The title is "you".

The attitude is "guidance and supervision".

"You're welcome, Director." Gu Chengan accepted the gift, "I just happened to be there, and anyone else would do the same thing."
